question: Which kinds of beings pervade the earth-world called Bhurloka?
premises: Bhurloka is pervaded by six classes: beasts, birds, deer, trees, humans, and reptiles.
It is also inhabited by pishachas, rakshasas, gandharvas, and yakshas.
inference: Bhurloka contains both ordinary embodied life-forms and various semi-divine or supernatural beings.
plain_english: This earth-world is filled with six kinds of beings: beasts, birds, deer, trees, humans, and reptiles. It is also inhabited by pishachas, rakshasas, gandharvas, and yakshas.
